map.婚姻财产 = 共同/个人划分: Marital property = community and separate division
map.婚前个人财产归各自所有（不参与分割）: Pre-marital separate property stays with each spouse and is not divided
map.📋 夫妻财产约定法律要点: 📋 Legal Points on Marital Property Agreements
map.《民法典》相关规定：: Relevant provisions of the Civil Code:
map.• 第1065条：男女双方可以约定婚姻关系存续期间所得的财产以及婚前财产归各自所: • Article 1065: a man and a woman may agree that property acquired during the marriage and pre-marital property belongs to each of them separately, to both jointly, or partly separately and partly jointly
map.• 约定应当采用书面形式: • The agreement must be in writing
map.• 对双方具有法律约束力: • It is legally binding on both spouses
map.• 约定财产归各自所有的，夫或妻一方对外所负的债务，相对人知道该约定的，以夫或妻: • Where property is agreed to be separate, a debt owed by one spouse to a third party who knew of the agreement is discharged from that spouse's separate property
map.• 建议公证增强效力: • Notarisation is recommended to strengthen it
map.• 不得恶意逃避债务: • It may not be used to evade debts in bad faith
map.• 内容应具体明确，避免歧义: • The terms should be specific and clear, avoiding ambiguity
map.婚前/婚内约定财产归属，按双方比例拆分各项财产金额。: Agree before or during the marriage how property is owned, and split each asset by the agreed ratios.
map.核对男女方比例合计是否为 100%，避免分配漏洞。: Check that the husband's and wife's ratios add to 100%, to avoid gaps.
map.对房产、存款、投资等逐项列示分配结果。: Show the allocation item by item for property, deposits and investments.
map.共同财产 300 万元，男方 60%、女方 40%：男方 180 万元、女方 1: Community property of ¥3,000,000 with 60% to the husband and 40% to the wife gives ¥1,800,000 and ¥1,200,000, and the ratios check out at 100%.
map.若其中 50 万为一方婚前财产不计入，可分割 250 万按约定比例分配。: If ¥500,000 of it is one spouse's pre-marital property and is excluded, ¥2,500,000 is divided at the agreed ratios.
map.婚内财产协议有效吗？: Is a marital property agreement valid?
map.有效，夫妻可约定婚内及婚前财产归属；涉及不动产建议办理公证或登记以增强对抗力。: Yes. Spouses may agree how marital and pre-marital property is owned; for real estate, notarisation or registration is recommended to strengthen it against third parties.
map.比例必须写整数吗？: Must the ratios be whole numbers?
map.不必，可约定任意比例甚至特定财产归一方；工具仅校验合计为 100% 便于核对。: No. Any ratio may be agreed, even allocating a specific asset to one spouse; the tool only checks that the ratios total 100%.
